protocol.hypothesis: A previously known EMA25 support/resistance state can filter Turtle 30/20 breakouts, and a previously known Turtle breakout state can filter EMA25 reactions; testing same and higher EMA source timeframes may improve monthly consistency on the full universe.

source_selection.ema: Archived broad-universe selection experiments/.history/retired-strategy-audit-2026-11-02/ema-level-25-atr05-long-short-1d-selection.json: EMA25, 0.5 ATR, 1D, 251 tickers, median net return +18.32%. This is historical seen-data evidence, not a new blind holdout.
source_selection.turtle: experiments/turtle/period-grid/results/all_variants.csv: dennis_turtle_30_20 on 1D, 263 tickers, median net return +4.14%; best median among tested timeframe-variant cells. Chosen before this combined run.
source_selection.scope_note: EMA source winner and Turtle source winner were both measured on 1D. Applying these fixed parameters on 1H/4H is a new transfer test; neither was separately optimal there.

protocol.parameter_rationale: Fixed winner parameters EMA25/0.5 ATR and Turtle entry30/exit20. Test both feasible EMA source relationships on the two lower execution intervals: same and one available higher interval, with three preregistered confirmation operators. Three bars is a short confluence window chosen before results. No per-ticker tuning.
protocol.baseline: Buy and hold 25% long on the same execution candles, next open, same transaction costs; EMA-only and Turtle-only are additional controls.
protocol.signal_rule: EMA signal is a FIRST TOUCH of the 0.5 ATR band around EMA25 with close above (long) or below (short), matching the source research. It is NOT a cross of two EMA lines. Turtle uses close beyond prior 30 completed highs/lows; exit uses prior 20 completed lows/highs. Higher-timeframe EMA signal becomes known only at the timestamp of the NEXT higher candle, never at the source candle open. 'turtle_entry_ema' admits Turtle entry only if latest known EMA signal has same direction; 'ema_entry_turtle' admits new EMA signal only if latest Turtle breakout state agrees; 'dual_event_3' admits Turtle entry only if matching EMA signal occurred on current or preceding 3 execution bars. Turtle exits always close regardless of filter. All orders execute next execution-bar open.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Rank broad-universe median monthly outcomes and downside against both single-rule controls; research only, no automatic paper promotion without fixed-rule parity and corporate-action review.
limitations: EMA25/0.5 ATR and Turtle30/20 were selected on previously seen history; this is not out-of-sample
The earlier EMA source applies to daily bars and may not transfer to 1H/4H
Daily candle is deliberately unavailable until the following daily candle starts
Dividend, split, short borrow and lot effects are not fully modelled

validation.note: DATA_READY confirms data and report gates only; it does not approve a trading strategy.
